fields.description: The Moodboard Surplus Fabric row this recolour belongs to, joined by fab_code rather than child-row name — a name hash changes on every full replace of the recommendations, fab_code does not.
fields.label: Fab Code

fields.description: Hex including the leading '#'. Named hex_code, not hex, to stay clear of the builtin.
fields.label: Hex

fields.description: The recoloured swatch. Written as a base64 data URL by sync_surplus_recolours, staged to /files, then offloaded to S3 by moodboard_media.offload_board on before_save.
fields.label: Image

fields.description: The recolour the user settled on for this fab code, when they picked one.
fields.label: Selected

fields.description: The stock batch the recolour was derived from, so the original swatch can be re-signed for a before/after view.
fields.label: Source Batch

fields.description: Free-form provenance (model, params, timestamp) — what lets a swatch be explained or regenerated later. NOT named `meta`: that is a frappe RESERVED_KEYWORD (BaseDocument.meta is a cached_property), so a column called `meta` is silently dropped by set()/update() and then overwritten with None by init_valid_columns, which clobbers the Meta object and makes every save of the parent board crash in _validate_links. The API still calls this field `meta` on the wire.
fields.label: Meta
